batting.name: Mohammad Hafeez
batting.dismissal: c MS Gony b M Ntini

balls.text: holds the length back a little, takes the pace off the ball, he makes room and clubs it over midwicket, the timing isn't enough to reach the boundary but they settle for a couple
exposes his stumps and he mows a full delivery across the line, Badrinath slides at midwicket to intercept it but they still pick up a couple
balaji gets predictable again with his slower balls and Saha walks across his stumps and executes a neat paddle scoop high over short fine leg
lovely slower ball again and this one lands on an unplayable yorker length, he manages to dig it out and scampers through for a single
fullish outside off, he squeezes it out to the offside for just a single
foxes him with the slower ball as he goes for the heave, the ball hits him just outside the line of the stumps but Balaji appeals anyway
fires in the yorker, he squeezes it out to the on side for a couple
attempts to heave it through the on side, he misses and gets a bye as Patel fumbles
Dropped: Morkel bangs it in short and Shukla plays the swivel pull, he miscues it towards Gony at long leg, he mistimes the forward drive and spills the catch
fires that full outside off, he drives it through the line to long-off
full outside off, he scoops it down to long-on
full outside off and he carves it wide of backward point for a welcome boundary
fullish and wide outside off, he pushes it down towards backward point
the slower ball, he makes room and pushes it to long-off
slips that wide outside off, loses his line here
pushed to the offside for a single
he attempts a premeditated paddle scoop and exposes all three stumps, he misses the stroke and meets the ball flush on the pads in front of middle, easy decision for Jayaprakash
poor start for Balaji as he searches for the yorker and slips in a low full toss, he exposes his stumps and carves it over extra cover
ends a superb over with a dot ball, Shukla taps it towards mid-off
fires that in on a good length, he taps it towards point
searches for the yorker but slips in a low full toss, Shukla waits on it, works his wrists and flicks it to the vacant area in the deep square leg region
just, nearly! He gets it to angle in sharply and Shukla gets forward and just manages to get some wood on it and steer it towards cover

timber and that;s two in two! Ntini gets it to angle in to the right hander, that's his stock delivery, Hussey is a little lazy to move across and cover the line and the ball skids through and hits the top of offstump, the stump goes for a tumble

Timely bowling change for Chennai! Delivers from wide of the crease and fires a low full toss, Das makes room to scoop it over mid-off but is beaten for pace, the ball takes out the legstump and sends it back by a few yards
Murali's nightmare over continues as Butt gets on his knee and slogs him once again, the ball races along the turf and beats the fielders in the region of deep midwicket
steps down the track and gets a thick outside edge which comfortably clears short third man, he made sure he got as much wood on it to clear the infield
lovely shot! Flighted on off and middle, he makes room and clubs it over midwicket
makes room to slice it wide of the infield on the offside but the big turn beats him
takes a few paces down and heaves it to deep midwicket
flighted on middle and leg, he tucks it to the on side
lovely improvisation from Butt as he walks across his stumps and paddle scoops it wide of short fine leg
Dropped: Butt steps down the track to short ball and clubs it towards midwicket, Vidyut leaps, appears to be in control but he grabs at it and spills the catch, that should go down as a chance
makes room and slices a low full toss down to Fleming at point, he hurls the ball back to the keeper who whips off the bails
slower ball, lands just short of a good length, he rocks back and punches it to long-on
good length outside off, he punches it to the infield on the offside
another slower ball directed down the legside, Butt sweeps and connects this time but Balaji does well to slide and intercept it
misdirects the slow legcutter down the legside, Butt follows it but misses the sweep
attempts the stroke again and the same result, Gony gives him a glare, scary, brrrrr!!
exposes all his stumps and goes for a mighty heave and misses
slightly slower in pace this time, he has enough time to rock back and slice it to sweeper cover to bring up his fifty
makes room and creams an overpitched delivery to long-off, there was a lot of power in that stroke but only for one run
slightly shorter in length, he hops and the ball trickles to the offside off his pads, he has to wait a bit longer for the fifty
false stroke from Butt as he attempts a cheeky glide to third man and misses it completely
he one again makes room to club it down the ground but the timing is all wrong as the ball trickles back to the bowler
makes room again to pierce the offside field but he mistimes it to mid-off
makes a bit of room to tuck it away to the on side but the ball skids through a lot quicker and he manages to place it back to the bowler
hits a good length outside off, he makes room and cuts it wide of extra cover
the slower ball, lands a little short but Butt pulls and just manages to beat midwicket, Murali picks it up in the deep
bowls this one a little short, though he's cramped for room he adjusts well by opening the face of the bat and gliding it down to third man
slides on the pads, he leans forward and pushes it to the vacant areas near midwicket for a couple
bang! Flighted on middle and leg, he gets on his knee early and is in perfect position to slog sweep, the ball lands a few rows over deep midwicket
slides on the pads, he nudges it to short fine leg
he steps down the track early, picks the length and gives it a mighty thwack a few rows over long -off, this was more emphatic than his earlier six
comes on straighter, he makes room and cuts it down to point
makes room, exposes his stumps and firmly pushes a full delivery down to long-off
fullish outside the offstump,  he drives through the line to long-off

that slips out of his hand and the ball goes into orbit! Ok I didn't mean that literally! He attempts a slower one and the ball lands somewhere in the region of fourth slip, Parthiv runs across and cuts it off, dead ball called
fullish outside off, he drives to sweeper cover
another slower ball but Butt fails to pick this one, he gets beaten on the drive and the ball rolls to the keeper
good shot! Balaji gets a little predictable with his slower deliveries, Butt picks it early, leans to the pitch of the ball and clears extra cover, the ball lands just a few inches short of the rope
the slower ball again, he leans forward and takes it on the full and places it to short midwicket
misdirects the legcutter really wide outside the offstump, too wide for Butt to stretch out and slice it
angles on the pads again, Das misses out on another scoring opportunity as he tucks it to midwicket this time
fullish on the pads, he softly tucks it away towards mid-on
fullish outside off, he taps it down to the offside
misfield! He angles it on the pads and Das flicks it away towards short fine leg, Vidyut is a little late on the slide and the ball slips through the gate and runs away to the boundary
hits a good length outside off, he opens the face of the bat and angles it wide of point
slightly short in length, he swings too early for the pull and mistimes it to square leg
that's a biggie! He gives it plenty of air on middle stump, he steps down the track and carts it away quite a distance from the long-on rope
hits a good length outside off, he pushes it to the off side
pitches on a fullish length, he drives through the line to long-on
the straighter one catches him low on the pad as he tries to sweep, Murali appeals but the umpire says no
skids through and catches Butt on the pads, the ball rolls towards point and they take the single anyway rather late
big offcutter from Murali, the first one he's turned today, he shuffles and tucks it away to the on side off the pads
bowls the slower one on the pads, he tucks it away down to fine leg
hits a good length outside off, he taps it wide of cover point
the ball again kicks up off a good length, he gets forward, adjusts well and angles it softly to third man
the slower ball, the legcutter, he reaches out and pushes it down to long-off
he bowls it a little short and grants him too much width outside off, he square cuts it past cover and sweeper cover picks it up
comes round the wicket, the ball kicks up off a good length and angles towards the body, he tucks it to the on side
slides on the pads, he paddles it but can't beat short fine leg
slightly shorter in length, he stays on the backfoot and whips it to the deep on the on side, they think of a second run though
the doosra i reckon, the ball seems to straighten after pitching, he taps it on the front foot towards point
gets on his knee early for the sweep and he places it a little wide of Balaji at fine leg
this one's flatter in trajectory, not much turn as he taps it to mid-off
flights it on the pads, he tucks it against the turn to deep square leg
he sees the short and swivels to pull, he fails to control the stroke and gets an inside edge onto his pads, the ball trickles towards square leg
gives him a bit of width outside off, he opens the face of the bat and pushes it wide of cover
fires it on a fullish length outside off, he taps it down to mid-off
hits a good length outside off and the ball holds its line, Das opts to shoulder arms and watch the movement
changes his line to outside the offstump, he punches it wide of cover and there's protection in the deep to cut it off
angles it in the direction of the pads, Butt uses his wrists and flicks it down to fine leg, the fielder is too square though to cut it off

timber! Ntini switches to over the wicket for Ganguly and fires it on a good length on middle stump line, Ganguly exposes all his stumps to cream it over the infield but plays far too early, the middle stump is flattened and the stump microphone is a mess
bangs it in short this time, he fails to control the pull and miscues it just over the reach of mid-on
good tactic by Ntini as he pitches it on the corridor outside off and beats the batsman, the ball straightens after pitching
the slower ball this time, it lands on a full length and he softly taps it back to the bowler
he slides it across the left hander again and Butt makes room for himself, he plays this a lot squarer and slashes it with control over backward point
Ntini angles it across the left hander and lands it on a fullish length, he makes room and creams it over mid-off and extra cover
hits the deck hard again and gets the ball to kick up, he opens the face of the bat and steers it to cover point, this is good stuff by Gony
Ganguly breaks the shackles by moving across his stumps and swiveling, he pulls it over square leg but there's protection in the deep
makes a bit of room to pierce the offside field, he mistimes it cover and that's another dot ball
good delivery, hits the deck hard and cramps him for room, he taps it back to the bowler
Butt swings and misses, the ball lands just short of a good length and dips suddenly before reaching the keeper, it goes on the first bounce to Parthiv Patel
hits a good length outside off, he softly taps it in front of cover
slides down the legside again, he nudges it off the pads to Balaji at fine leg
slides on the pads, he nudges it off his pads to the on side
lovely ball, it angles into Ganguly and suddenly shapes away after pitching, it squares Ganguly up on the drive and nearly gets an outside edge to Patel
tests him out with a short ball from wide of the crease, it angles into Ganguly and he hops and uneasily fends it off
Nitini slides down the legside, he shuffles across and flicks it uppishly down to fine leg, he times it a little too well and places it straight to Gony who takes it comfortably
hafeez packs a punch this time, the ball was fractionally short outside off, he rocks back and punches it much squarer, beats the gap between cover and extra cover

crisply timed bu Butt, the ball hits a good length and holds its line, Butt makes use of the width and punches it through the arc between mid-off and cover, he didn't have to do much, the outfield did the rest
holds the length back a little and gives him width to slash, Butt misses it completely and the ball nearly takes the edge
full in length this time outside off, he shuffles and tucks it to mid-on
beaten, a false stroke by Butt as he leans forward and fails to get to pitch of the ball on the drive
hits a good length outside off and he taps it softly towards cover
another mis-hit, this time by Hafeez, the ball kicks up on him and he closes the face of the bat and gets a thick leading edge down to third man
delivers from wide of the crease, the ball stops on Butt and as a result he miscues it towards mid-off, the ball was well short of the fielder though
Free Hit: He bangs it in short and Hafeez misses his chance as he backs away and misses it completely, the ball lobs off Dhoni's glove
he oversteps, slides it on a middle and off line and he works it to fine leg
gets this one to angle across and land in front of the pads, he gets across his stumps and tucks it wide of midwicket
continues from slightly wide of the crease again, he gets a half stride forward and taps it past the bowler
delivers from slightly wide of the crease, Butt gets on the backfoot and punches it back past the bowler and towards mid-off again
makes him play immediately, he's drawn forward into the drive and he softly pushes it to mid-off
pitches outside off, he shapes to drive but misses
slides down the leg side,he trickles it off his pads and the ball races to fine leg
Dropped: Patel hooks a short delivery and miscues it, the top edge sends the ball sailing in the air for like ages and Dinda spills a straightforward chance at long leg
bowls the slower one this time and beats him outside the offstump
slides on the pads, he whips it to the on side for a single
slides wide down the legside, he attempts to nudge it down fine but misses
bangs it in short of a length, he swings and pulls to the on side

taps it just wide of Shukla at mid-off and sets off, Shukla for some reason hesitates before throwing and eventually knocks the stumps down after Patel makes his ground, why did we wait? Otherwise Patel would have gone, surely!
pushes a full delivery through the line firmly towards mid-off, no single this time
he taps it with soft hands towards mid-off and sets off quickly for a single, he takes advantage of the fact that the fielder is on the edge of the circle
fires that on a fullish length outside off, he squeezes it out towards cover
swivels early to pull a delivery which was fractionally short, he mistimes it towards square leg
pitches it on a fullish length, perhaps searching for the swing, he pushes it softly towards mid-off who's fairly deep and that allows the single
the angle towards the pads gets predictable here but Patel fails to tuck it wide of midwicket this time
angles in towards the pads again, he nudges it off his pads for a legbye
swings in to the left hander and he tucks it to the on side after exposing his stumps
angles in towards the pads, he tucks it away to short fine leg

another defensive push finds the boundary! Patel punches it softly on the up past the bowler and places it wide of mid-off, the outfield may have added a few miles to the speed at which the ball travelled
hits a good length outside off and comes in with the angle, he tucks it just wide of midwicket
takes this from outside the offstump and whips across the line to midwicket with a good use of the wrists
fullish outside the offstump, he drives softly through the line just wide of mid-off

That was just fractionally wide and Fleming merely executes a defensive push, the timing is exquisite and the placement even better as he pierces the packed infield square of the wicket on the offside
slashes it hard along the ground and Taibu effects a brilliant athletic save to his right and saves a certain boundary
this one keeps a little low, he just manages to cover the line and tap it firmly back to the bowler
swings it into the left hander, he gets forward and times it to mid-off
shuffles across a little, turns the face of the bat and turns it towards mid-on and sets off for a quick single, he dives at the non-striker's end and the under-arm flick sails over the stumps
the angle is slightly wider outside the offstump, he taps it in front of point and contemplates the single
taps it down on the pitch with soft hands and Patel calls for the run quickly
fullish and slightly wide outside the offstump, he covers the line for the offdrive but places it towards extra cover
gets across his stumps just a touch and tucks it towards midwicket
hits a good length on off and middle, he closes the face of the bat and works it behind square on the on side
bangs it in short of a length and the ball doesn't come onto Fleming all that quick, he has time to get on top of the bounce, swivel and pull along the ground past square leg
the crowd roar as he runs in, he fires it on off and middle and Flemo just gets his bat down on time and tucks it down to square leg
gets a thick inside edge as he plays away from his body and the ball nearly trickles onto his stumps
he errs by firing it on the pads and that's all too easy for Flemo as he whips it away wide of fine leg, the fielder is too square to get across
bangs it in short and Patel adjusts really well as he opens the face of the bat, leans backward  and dabs it deliberately down to third man
fullish outside off, he leans forward and pushes it through the line just wide of mid-off
slides on the pads this time and Fleming whips it wide of square leg with a good use of the wrists, Agarkar slides in vain to cut it off but the outfield was a little too quick for him
fires that on a good length outside off, Fleming opens the blade late and taps it very softly, he keeps it wide of second slip and third man is too square to cut it off
strays on the body this time and he shuffles and tucks it away down to fine leg

superb timing! Ishant gives him just a bit of width outside off, he opens the face of the bat and meets the ball on an angle, he strikes it off the meat of the bat and the ball just beats the diving cover fielder
pitches on middle and comes on straight, he angles it down towards backward point, this is a good line by Ishant
runs in hard and fires that on a good length in the region of offstump, the batsman is cramped for room as he taps it down to mid-off
fires in a low full toss on the pads and Fleming gets across and chips it over the region of square leg, that ends a long over
strays a little wide on the pads, Patel moves across just a touch and flicks it on the up to fine leg
delivers from slightly wide of the crease, fires that in on a good length, he rocks backwards and defends to the offside off the meat of the bat
he finds his rhythm now as he bangs it short and gets it to climb on Patel, he hops and fends it off with control, good cricket all round
hits a good line and length outside the offstump, pitches on the channel and holds its line before reaching the keeper
the first legal delivery of the innings, he pitches it on a good length outside leg and the ball skids and strikes him on the pad and rolls to the offside
this time he sprays it well wide of the offstump, that ankle must be disturbing his rhythm
bad start for Shoaib as he slides this one down the legside, wide called
